title: [Docs] Add notice for Boost and Boost.Regex under PowerRename

proposed_comments.title: Remove the retired Boost.Regex package from the notice

confidence.rationale: The merged removal commit and pinned native package declarations show the package is retired, while pinned source still uses Boost.Regex.

proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the retired Boost.Regex package from the notice

**Severity:** `medium`

Could we remove `boost_regex-vc143` from this sentence and the NuGet package list, while retaining the Boost/Boost.Regex license attribution? #51002 removed that package and its prebuilt DLLs; PowerRename still uses Boost.Regex from the `boost` headers. The current notice therefore identifies a package that is no longer used.
